about.text: Caboc is a Scottish cream cheese made from double cream or cream-enriched milk, formed into a log and rolled in toasted pinhead oatmeal. It is rennet-free, with about 67-69 % fat, and is served with oatcakes. It is said to go back to the 15th century and was a cheese of the wealthy, unlike crowdie.
